content: हरणम् [हृ-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Seizing, taking. .²2 Carrying away, carrying off, removing, stealing; कन्याहरणम् <ls>Ms. 3. 33</ls>; धेनुवत्सहरणम् <ls>R. 11. 74</ls>. .²3 Depriving of, destroying; as in प्राणहरणम्. .²4 Dividing. .²5 A gift to a student. .²6 The arm. .²7 Semen virile. .²8 Gold. .²9 A nuptial present. (= यौतक <ab>q. v.</ab>); आजग्मुः खाण्डवप्रस्थमादाय हरणं बहु <ls>Mb. 1. 221. 33</ls>. .²10 A shell, cowrie. .²11 Boiling water.
